classify_g1: knee measured in a valid exp1

G2.procedure: A4+A5 paced warm-up+A6 240 s back to back

gap.limitation: The interval treats the 40 accepted pairs as interchangeable. Dependence within and between blocks (drift, cache or idle state, ambient) is not modelled, so the interval may be too narrow. Per-block gaps are diagnostics only; they do not remove this limitation and cannot change the classification.

G4.ties_note: worst-median orderings tied at 0.0: alternating, random

p99_estimator.meaning: ascending sort x[0..599]: P99 = x[593] + 0.01*(x[594]-x[593]), i.e. the 7th largest value interpolated 1% toward the 6th largest
